messages: I gave the #b#t4031011##k to #p102# in #m10000000# and received #b#t4031009##k in return. Now, all I need to do is get this to #b#p207##k, and I'll finally be done. The deeper I get into this, the more I regret saying yes. Anyway, this medicine looks quite tasty. If I ever find myself thirsty and without any water, maybe I should just drink it myself. Hahaha...

I went back to #m10001000# and handed #p207# the Weird Medicine. Hopefully it'll help her get better. As a sign of thanks, #p207# gave me some Mesos and a #b#t1002081##k. The hat... I mean, it looked like it'd protect me from the sun, but it was so old and raggedy... And when I put it on, it made this weird noise... It felt like insects were moving around inside it... Am I going to be okay?
name: Delivering the Weird Medicine
